info.title: SCM LME Snapshot Update-by-id API
info.description: Updates one or more LME snapshot rows by id, mirroring the Dataverse update-row tool.

patch.description: Update one or more rows in the LME snapshots table. Provide 'recordId' and 'item' to update a single record, or provide 'records' (an array of {recordId, item} objects) to update multiple records in one call (returns a per-record result summary). Updatable fields in 'item': report_date_label, payload_json, name, status_code, state_code, version_number. Unknown fields are rejected per-record rather than failing the whole call.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Either {recordId, item} for a single-record update, or {records: [{recordId, item}, ...]} for a batch update.

recordId.description: The snapshot's database id (UUID) to update. Use with 'item' for a single-record update.

item.description: Fields to update on the record identified by 'recordId': any of report_date_label, payload_json, name, status_code, state_code, version_number.

records.description: For a batch update: an array of {recordId, item} objects, each shaped like the single-record fields above.
